title: 73 Pond Cypress Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 73 Pond Cypress Circle is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Located in the heart of WaterColor’s Camp District, 73 Pond Cypress Circle balances privacy, luxury, and walkable convenience. This 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath home spans nearly 4,900 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, combining high-end finishes with a warm, comfortable feel for a true coastal retreat. With tranquil views, a private pool and spa, and inviting outdoor spaces designed for gathering, this home is ideal for family vacations and group getaways. Guests are just a short stroll or bike ride from Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, and Seaside, putting the best of 30A moments from the front door.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 14 Passes Included 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 3 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available) Private Pool With Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Summer Kitchen Natural Gas Grill Outdoor Fireplace Exterior Shower Sonos Sound System Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Camp District 3-Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Surrounded by lush native landscaping and tranquil preserve views, 73 Pond Cypress Circle offers a perfect balance of luxury and relaxation. Inside, the open-concept kitchen and living area welcome guests with abundant natural light, high-end finishes, and a seamless flow for entertaining. Five king bedrooms with private baths provide comfort and privacy for adults, while the third-floor loft—complete with a kitchenette and twin-over-queen bunks, serves as an ideal retreat for younger guests or extended family. Outside, enjoy the private pool and spa framed by natural stone decking and a charming cabana. The outdoor fireplace, summer kitchen, and full Sono's sound system creates an inviting environment for poolside dining and evening gatherings under the stars. Located just steps from Camp WaterColor and a short bike ride to the Beach Club and Seaside, this home places guests near everything that makes WaterColor special while maintaining a sense of privacy and peacefulness.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Laundry Area Half Bath Kitchen Living Room Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Third Floor Bunk Room: Two Twin-Over-Queen Bunk Beds (Sleeps 6), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Carriage House Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Life in WaterColor Located in the Camp District, this home offers quick access to family-friendly amenities, including pools, playgrounds, and sports courts. Spend mornings at Camp WaterColor, afternoons by the Beach Club, and evenings exploring the nearby boutiques and dining in Seaside, all easily reached by bike. 73 Pond Cypress Circle delivers the quintessential WaterColor experience: spacious, private, and perfectly situated for memorable gatherings with family and friends. Guest may rent a cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor only allows one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
